changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Keep photo correlation unchanged for energy-only point updates; retain all interpolation-input changes.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION queue_media_correlation_for_updated_track_points() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$ BEGIN INSERT INTO media_correlation_track_work(track_id, reason, requested_at) WITH changed AS ( SELECT previous.gps_track_data_id AS previous_data_id, updated.gps_track_data_id AS updated_data_id FROM old_points previous FULL JOIN new_points updated USING (id) WHERE previous.id IS NULL OR updated.id IS NULL OR ROW(previous.gps_track_data_id, previous.point_timestamp, previous.point_index, previous.interval_status, previous.distance_in_meter_since_start, previous.duration_since_start, previous.point_altitude, ST_AsEWKB(previous.point_long_lat)) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(updated.gps_track_data_id, updated.point_timestamp, updated.point_index, updated.interval_status, updated.distance_in_meter_since_start, updated.duration_since_start, updated.point_altitude, ST_AsEWKB(updated.point_long_lat)) ), affected_data AS ( SELECT previous_data_id AS id FROM changed UNION SELECT updated_data_id FROM changed ) SELECT DISTINCT data.gps_track_id, 'canonical_points_update', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM affected_data point JOIN gps_track_data data ON data.id = point.id WHERE data.track_type = 'RAW_OUTLIER_CLEANED' ON CONFLICT (track_id) DO UPDATE SET reason = EXCLUDED.reason, requested_at = EXCLUDED.requested_at; RETURN NULL; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

rollback.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION queue_media_correlation_for_updated_track_points() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$ BEGIN INSERT INTO media_correlation_track_work(track_id, reason, requested_at) SELECT DISTINCT data.gps_track_id, 'canonical_points_update', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM ( SELECT gps_track_data_id FROM old_points UNION SELECT gps_track_data_id FROM new_points ) point JOIN gps_track_data data ON data.id = point.gps_track_data_id WHERE data.track_type = 'RAW_OUTLIER_CLEANED' ON CONFLICT (track_id) DO UPDATE SET reason = EXCLUDED.reason, requested_at = EXCLUDED.requested_at; RETURN NULL; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
